evals.prompt: My Spice queries against Postgres are taking 2-3 seconds each. How can I speed them up? The table is about 500MB and updates a few times per hour.
evals.expected_output: Enable acceleration with appropriate engine, set refresh_check_interval to match update frequency

evals.prompt: I'm streaming events from Kafka into Spice. What refresh mode should I use? The events are append-only and I never need to update old ones.
evals.expected_output: Use refresh_mode: append for streaming, no time_column needed for continuous streaming

assertions.name: recommends_append_mode
assertions.description: Should recommend append refresh mode for streaming

evals.prompt: My accelerated dataset keeps growing and I'm running out of disk space. It's an events table and I only need the last 30 days. How do I set up automatic cleanup?
evals.expected_output: Configure retention policy with retention_period: 30d and retention_check_enabled: true
